items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: That's when I started working with Mack Muramaker and them.

ctx.x: And then after you left the Nighthaw, what happened?

Then I, uh, went home. Going to Pensacola. Went to Pensacola. You played solo there, or you worked with bands? I worked with bands. That's when I started working with Mack Muramaker and them. I was in the town playing around. Tallahassee and Quincy and, um, Panama City, Florida. Appalachicola. Appalachicola, Florida. Oh, I had a good time on Appalachicola. Hey, at Jimmy Home. Appalachicola. And, um, all the through Florida. We've just been all around through this town like that, you know? Now, during the…
you shit a barking. We don't want you barking.
